It is carried ENTIRELY by the hidden scale-selection coordinate (last basis vector = 1) with only a vanishing eps leakage onto the EW input-knobs (the source can reach the predicate only by TUNING; the leakage -> 0 under refinement).
toy_model.D0_dissolving_source_probe: the source EW broken-phase readouts (W/Z masses, Weinberg angle, Higgs mass & couplings, neutral-current/parity amplitudes) modeled as responses to the n_inputs EW knobs. toy_model.refinement: h <- resolve more EW input-knobs (n_inputs 4 -> 8, the honest finer enumeration of the source carrier) AND shrink the tuning leakage eps (0.10 -> 0.01); the scale-selection coordinate remains outside the source knobs' span (the quadratic cutoff-sensitivity does NOT decay).

rationale: electroweak_theory -> electroweak-hierarchy is an UP (emergence) edge into an open_question node (the scalar-sector naturalness / electroweak hierarchy problem). The target node-kind already forces the E0/E3 branch (can never seal E1/E2). The descent test was nonetheless run and fails decisively: the normalized residual xi_rel is stable-positive and pinned near 1.0 (0.988 -> 0.999) across two refinements, never machine-zero; the reverse blind-spot residual locates the obstruction at the scale-selection coordinate (xi_rel -> 1 as tuning leakage -> 0). Non-factorization (B.2) holds: states identical in the EW lens (same W/Z masses, Weinberg angle, Higgs couplings) are distinguished by the WHY-this-scale predicate, so the EW scale's smallness is non-definable from below -- emergence-up is the PRIMARY modality (no structural DOWN modality closes it; emergence-up E1 is forbidden by B.8). Recognition-search returns NOTHING NAMED: SUSY, compositeness, and anthropic/landscape are contested competing candidates, not a single frozen community-accepted import -- so NOT a recognition-landing and NOT E2. Run-search finds no constructible non-descending run-object generating m_H/v (contrast QCD's Lambda via dimensional transmutation in E001); the EW vev and Higgs mass are FREE MEASURED INPUTS to the SM, and E0 is not a doubt-haven, so NOT E0. The edge forecloses to E3: a sharpened, LOCATED gap (the quadratic cutoff-sensitivity of the scalar mass; no accepted completion selects the scale), explicitly NOT closed. SBT is SILENT on the hierarchy -- the predicted foreclosure-dominant shape.
